description: Fork of exp365 (bs=16 SOTA: 1.6215 @ 43M, soft mode). Single change: switch ALL 4 TinyMHLut modules (qkv, v, out_proj, residual) from backward_mode='soft' to 'soft_topk' with n_alternatives=3. Tests whether soft's edge over STE-n3 (validated again at bs=192 in exp401: +0.05 bpb gap) comes from the SOFT MATH (softmax-based attribution) or from the K=2^NAP alternatives count. soft_topk-3 uses softmax attribution restricted to 1+3=4 rows (chosen + 3 best 1-bit-flip neighbors), keeping all other math identical to soft. If exp402 matches exp365 → soft math is the lever (motivates kernel). If closer to ste-n3 quality → K=256 alternatives matters more. Everything else identical to exp365.
